housekeeping_list_item_1: Keep side conversations to a minimum.
housekeeping_list_item_2: Questions are encouraged, including basic ones!
housekeeping_list_item_3: Share the information you receive, do not reveal the identity of who said it.
housekeeping_list_item_4: Please refrain from taking photographs of other people without their permission.
housekeeping_list_item_5: Let the conversation flow, keep things concrete and focused.
